title: fedimint: 0.5.1 -> 0.7.1
reason: Real, substantial restructuring: the single 'api' section is split into 'api_ws' (renamed/renarrowed) and a brand new 'api_iroh' section, plus a brand new 'ui' section (all real new mkOptions), and nginx path options renamed (path -> path_ui/path_ws).
targets_toml: option_prefix=[services,fedimintd], watch=[api_ws.openFirewall]. 'services.fedimintd' is itself types.attrsOf(types.submodule(...)) (per-instance config), but unlike kanidm's wildcards, fields within it ARE discoverable here (28 discovered_options) -- another same-shape-but-working wildcard instance, alongside drupal's sites and frp's instances.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: REAL ACTIONABLE FINDING: uncovered option branch, no test assignment flips 'api_ws.openFirewall' away from its default false.
